Name: Unexpected movement while driving
Subsystem: The unexpected-movement detector and its reaction
Purpose: The detector suspends during direct drive, so it can only be provoked while a behaviour is driving the body. Its thresholds came from the engine and have never been pushed against.
ExpectedTelemetry: an unexpected movement report naming the side, then the reaction
ExpectedPhysical: He plays the startled reaction once, on the side the push came from, and nothing fires while he drives freely.
InterruptedReason: stopped part way (emergency stop or Ctrl+C)
Warnings: note: could not open a connection to confirm the motors are stopped (TimeoutException). If he is still moving, pick him up or put him on his back.
